premises.text: Contextual game-mechanic communication drives highly engaged web audiences
premises.evidence_span: They use contextual communication to the user to drive behavior at that right moment in time

premises.text: Web publishers lack tools to recognize and reward online loyalty the way offline programs do
premises.evidence_span: online, it's very difficult for us to get recognized and rewarded for our attention and our loyalty. Right? What's missing is publishers don't really have the tools to do so

premises.text: Publishers can flexibly define behaviors, rewards, iconography, and points on the platform
premises.evidence_span: Our platform allows publishers to have a highly flexible way to define their behaviors and their rewards

premises.text: The platform supplies engagement analytics on top users, behaviors, and community health
premises.evidence_span: Who are your top users? What behaviors are they performing? How engaged are they? What's the health of your community?

premises.text: Install is easy via registration plug-in, embed codes, turnkey widgets, or API
premises.evidence_span: we give you all of the embed codes as a publisher so that you can immediately start tracking

premises.text: Users can import social graphs and invite friends to compete on the publisher site
premises.evidence_span: I can actually import my social graph into this site and compare my performance here with my friends

value.evidence_span: We're here to maximize engagement for publishers

causal_links.evidence_span: leverage proven techniques from game mechanics
These are the kinds of analytics we can provide to our clients

notes: Singleton D3 retained: analytics presented as its own publisher-facing module. Revenue/customer traction excluded. Demo behaviors (badges, leaderboards) treated as instances of P3, not extra premises.
